card.name: Scattered punctuation in formal prose
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on scattered spots in formal or scholarly prose, such as a comma after an opening phrase, a colon, or the first digit of a year range.
card.plain: It responds to assorted punctuation and small words in formal writing, with no clear pattern among them.
